title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. The first loop consists of four lines: the first line starts at the origin and ends at [0.01, 0.0]; the second line starts at [0.01, 0.0] and ends at [0.01, 0.01]; the third line starts at [0.01, 0.01] and ends at [0.0, 0.01]; the fourth line starts at [0.0, 0.01] and returns to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.01 to the sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions without any additional rotation or translation. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base are 0.01 units in length, 0.01 units in width, and 0.75 units in height. The resulting shape is a cylindrical object with a small cylindrical protrusion at the top.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.01, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.01, 0.01) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.01) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

import cadquery as cq

r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Sketch the top profile
r = r.moveTo(0, 0.001) \
    .threePointArc((0.00075, 0.00075), (0.001, 0)) \
    .lineTo(0.009, 0) \
    .threePointArc((0.00925, 0.00075), (0.01, 0.001)) \
    .lineTo(0.01, 0.009) \
    .threePointArc((0.00925, 0.00925), (0.009, 0.01)) \
    .lineTo(0.001, 0.01) \
    .threePointArc((0.00075, 0.00925), (0, 0.009)) \
    .lineTo(0, 0.001) \
    .close()

# Extrude the profile to create the body
r = r.extrude(0.75)
